manifest.name: dsh-nushell
manifest.description: Run DeepSeek Harness's bash tool with Nushell

bundle.text:
# Keep the installed standard preset's configuration as the source of truth.
# The adapter replaces its shell tool group without changing other presets.
- id: preset-standard
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: nushell-standard
      name: dsh-nushell/preset

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

`dsh-nushell` 是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web Profile Bundle，在默认 `standard` Agent preset 中用 [Nushell](https://www.nushell.sh/) 执行 DSH 内置的 `bash` 工具。

面向模型的工具名称和参数仍保持为 `bash`，但命令会以 `nu --no-config-file -c <command>` 运行。用户的 `config.nu` 和 `env.nu` 不会影响工具调用；后台任务、权限审批、沙箱、超时和输出处理继续使用 DSH 的原有机制。

- 适配 DSH `0.2` 系列（以下载的 `0.2.1-alpha.1` 源码为基准），并使用 Node.js `>=22.19.0`。
- 已安装 Nushell，并能通过 `PATH` 中的 `nu` 调用。若需使用其他位置的可执行文件，请在启动 DSH 前将 `DSH_NU_PATH` 设置为其绝对路径。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nushell
```

安装后重启 Web Profile，并新建一个使用 `standard` preset 的会话。已有会话可能继续保留旧 preset 的配置。

插件读取当前已安装的 `standard` preset 配置，只替换 Bash/PowerShell 工具，并将 Nushell 执行器放入独立的 shell 隔离域。其他 preset 不受影响；原 `preset-standard` 配置仍是来源，应保持禁用，由 `nushell-standard` 负责注册。修改来源配置后重启 Profile。

先安装依赖并构建：

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run test:smoke

生成引用本机构建产物绝对路径的补丁：

```powershell
pnpm run patch:local
```

该命令从 `cordis.patch.yml` 生成未纳入 Git 的 `cordis.patch.local.yml`，并将 preset 适配器替换为本机 `dist/preset.js` 的绝对 `file:///` 路径。适配器使用同目录的 `sandbox.js` 和 `tool.js`。

使用该补丁启动 DSH：

```powershell
dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.local.yml
```

修改源码后，先重新构建，再运行 `pnpm run patch:local`。

工具仍叫 `bash`，但必须编写 Nushell 语法：

```nu
ls | where type == file | get name
open package.json | get name
$env.DSH_WEB_URL
```

后台执行使用 `run_in_background`，通过 `job_output` 收集输出、`job_kill` 停止任务。默认情况下，有后台任务服务时，前台命令达到超时会转为后台任务；工具配置 `promoteOnTimeout: false` 可改为超时终止。缺少后台任务服务时会按超时终止。

每次调用都会创建新的 Nushell 进程。请使用工具的 `workdir` 参数，不要依赖前一次调用的 `cd` 状态。

- Shell 状态、别名和变量不会在工具调用之间持久化。
- 为了兼容性，公开工具名仍是 `bash`；插件自己的 consumer 会将其描述和系统提示固定为 Nushell 语义。
- 执行器将隔离委托给 DSH 沙箱，并按当前 runner 的拒绝特征分类文件访问拒绝和 runner 故障。
- 默认补丁面向 Web 的 `standard` preset；其他 preset 需要单独配置。

English | [中文](README.md)

`dsh-nushell` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web profile bundle that runs the standard Agent preset’s `bash` tool with [Nushell](https://www.nushell.sh/).

The model-facing tool keeps the stable `bash` name and arguments, but commands are evaluated as `nu --no-config-file -c <command>`. User `config.nu` and `env.nu` cannot affect tool calls; DSH background jobs, permission approvals, sandbox integration, timeouts, and output handling remain available.

- DSH `0.2` series (adapted against the downloaded `0.2.1-alpha.1` source) running on Node.js `>=22.19.0`.
- Nushell available as `nu` on `PATH`. To use another executable, set `DSH_NU_PATH` to its absolute path before launching DSH.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nushell
```

Restart the Web profile and create a new session using the `standard` preset. Existing sessions may retain their earlier preset revision.

The adapter reads the installed standard preset, replaces its Bash/PowerShell tools, and isolates the Nushell shell service within that tool group. Other presets retain their own shell. Keep the source `preset-standard` row disabled: `nushell-standard` registers its adapted configuration. Restart the profile after editing the source configuration.

Install dependencies and build the package:

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run test:smoke

Generate a patch that references the local build through absolute paths:

```powershell
pnpm run patch:local
```

This generates the Git-ignored `cordis.patch.local.yml` from `cordis.patch.yml`, replacing the adapter with the absolute `file:///` path to `dist/preset.js`. It resolves `sandbox.js` and `tool.js` from the same directory.

Start DSH with the generated patch:

```powershell
dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.local.yml
```

After a source change, rebuild and run `pnpm run patch:local` again.

The tool is still named `bash`, but write Nushell:

```nu
ls | where type == file | get name
open package.json | get name
$env.DSH_WEB_URL
```

Use `run_in_background` to start a job, `job_output` to collect output, and `job_kill` to stop it. With a job registry available, foreground calls are promoted to background on timeout by default; set the tool’s `promoteOnTimeout: false` to kill them instead. Without a job registry, the timeout kills the command.
Each invocation is a new process. Use the tool's `workdir` argument rather than depending on a prior `cd` command.

- Shell state, aliases, and variables do not persist between tool calls.
- For compatibility, the public tool name remains `bash`; this package's own consumer makes its schema description and system prompt Nushell-specific.
- The executor delegates confinement to the DSH sandbox and classifies file denials and sandbox-runner failures with the active runner's diagnostics.

- The default patch targets the Web `standard` preset; other presets require separate configuration.
